title: Cumulative UAP reports vs cases flagged unexplained

source.name: Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
source.publisher: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO), U.S. Department of Defense

notes: As of October 24, 2024, AARO had received 1,652 UAP reports total since the office opened. Only 21 of those were flagged as having 'anomalous characteristics and/or behaviors' that merit further analysis -- the rest were resolved as balloons, drones, aircraft, birds, or other mundane explanations.
